judgment_text:
Prayer in W.P. No. 16870 of 2019: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue Writ of Mandamus, to forbear the 3rd respondent its men, agents, servants and other from interfering with the petitioner's peaceful possession and enjoyment of the Retail out let of the petitioner situated in T.S. No. 25/2, Ward-K, Block-I, Victoria roads illegally closed leading to the retail outlet and pass orders.

Prayer in W.P. No. 18439 of 2019: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents not to disturb peaceful possession and enjoyment of retail outlet in T.S. No. 25/2, Ward-K, Block Victoria Market Road, in Sub-Registration District of Salem and not to evict the petitioner except by due process of law and pass orders.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

G. Jayachandran, J.:— Heard the Learned Counsel for the petitioners and the Learned Counsel for the respondents.

2. The grievance of the petitioners is that, they are running Petroleum out let in the Salem City and the land upon which they are running the Petroleum out let is now sought to be acquired for Smart City Project and since their livelihood been deprived due to the acquisition, they seek alternate site.

3. After notice and few rounds of negotiation, now the petitioners as well as the respondents have identified the alternate site and the 2nd respondent/Assistant Commissioner, Salem Corporation, have offered 5040 sq.ft of vacant land in T.S. No. 18 at Division 50, Mayanur sandhi, which has been accepted by the writ petitioner in W.P. No. 18439 of 2019. Similarly, 8005 sq.ft of land near new Bus Stand, East of Ganesh Mahal Hotel and A.S.N Coimbatore Jewellers has been allotted to the writ petitioner in W.P. No. 16870 of 2019.

4. Recording the same, the Writ Petitions are disposed. The petitioners herein shall remove the balance materials kept in the existing place immediately. The respondents are hereby directed to earmark the identified portion and handover the possession to the petitioners, within a period of four weeks, after duly entering into lease agreement with the petitioners. No costs. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
